material_gaps: Held EO 9521 (10 FR 1991) revokes EO 9431 only 'as of the dates of issuance of the orders or regulations of the Secretary of State that cover the subject-matter of and supersede' it; no Secretary of State order superseding Foreign Service Regulations sections IV-9 and IV-10 is held, so neither the ending date nor the ending itself is established. Needed: the Department of State order/regulation (Federal Register, 1945 onward) designating EO 9431 as superseded.
